title: Forward+ on Adreno 740 (Galaxy S23 Ultra): driver fails to compile internal pipelines, `VkResult error -13`, with the default material
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf), 4.8.dev7 (c971f93e7)
- Not reproducible with the Mobile renderer (same device, same project)

### System information

Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (SM-S918B), Android 16 (build BP4A.251205.006.S918BXXSAFZI1, security patch 2026-09-05), Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (kalama), Adreno 740, Vulkan driver 0676.77.1, Vulkan 1.3.128 - Forward+

### Issue description

With the Forward+ renderer on this device, the Adreno driver fails to compile some of Godot's internal pipelines. This happens with an empty scene that has one `BoxMesh` with the default material and one `DirectionalLight3D`, so no custom shaders are involved.

The driver logs a shader compilation or link failure right before each error:

```
I AdrenoVK-0: Shader compilation failed for shaderType: 5
I AdrenoVK-0: Pipeline create failed
E godot   : ERROR: Couldn't create Vulkan compute pipelines (VkResult error -13).
E godot   :    at: compute_pipeline_create (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:6742)
E godot   : ERROR: Condition "!pipeline.driver_id" is true. Returning: RID()
E godot   :    at: compute_pipeline_create (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5048)

I AdrenoVK-0: Failed to link shaders.
I AdrenoVK-0: Pipeline create failed
E godot   : ERROR: Couldn't create Vulkan graphics pipelines (VkResult error -13).
E godot   :    at: render_pipeline_create (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:6237)
E godot   : ERROR: Condition "!pipeline.driver_id" is true. Returning: RID()
E godot   :    at: render_pipeline_create (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4960)
E godot   :    at: _create_pipeline (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/scene_shader_forward_clustered.cpp:506)
```

- Minimal project (4.7.2): 1 compute pipeline and 1 graphics pipeline fail on startup.
- Full game (4.7.2): about 25 graphics pipeline failures per launch, one for each lit material variant.
- Full game (4.8.dev7): 23 graphics failures plus 1 compute failure. After that, thousands of errors per second (`Uniforms were never supplied for set (0) at the time of drawing`, `Image (binding: 0, index 0) is not a valid texture`, from `compute_list_dispatch` and `get_texture_slice_view`), and the image looks washed out.

The device's updatable driver packages (`com.samsung.gamedriver.sm8550` and `com.qualcomm.qti.gpudrivers.kalama.api33`) are stubs, so the per-app driver preference cannot switch drivers. The vendor driver 0676.77.1 is always loaded.

Possibly related (same device, different symptom): #101635.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create the project below (Forward+ on desktop and mobile).
2. Export for Android (arm64-v8a, standard debug template, no Gradle build) and run it on an Adreno 740 device.
3. Watch `adb logcat -s godot:* AdrenoVK-0:*`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The project is just two text files:

`project.godot`
```ini
config_version=5

[application]

config/name="VkRepro"
run/main_scene="res://main.tscn"

[rendering]

renderer/rendering_method="forward_plus"
renderer/rendering_method.mobile="forward_plus"
textures/vram_compression/import_etc2_astc=true
```

`main.tscn`
```
[gd_scene load_steps=2 format=3]

[sub_resource type="BoxMesh" id="1"]

[node name="Main" type="Node3D"]

[node name="Camera3D" type="Camera3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 0.94, 0.34, 0, -0.34, 0.94, 0, 1, 3)

[node name="DirectionalLight3D" type="DirectionalLight3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(0.87, -0.25, 0.43, 0, 0.87, 0.5, -0.5, -0.43, 0.75, 0, 3, 0)

[node name="MeshInstance3D" type="MeshInstance3D" parent="."]
mesh = SubResource("1")
```

Full logcat available on request.
